summary.text: Joe Canino, a Republican, has represented District 65 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 8, 2025, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Torrington, Connecticut, and earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University.

His career includes work as a press secretary for Connecticut Senate Republicans and as a legislative associate, and he served as a Wing Commander in the U.S. Air Force Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
